value.rationale: A motivated exact gain-selection theorem for the scalar feedback family in fully observed quadratic control. Unlike a fixed matching shift or an abstract bound, it gives a unique optimal parameter, sharp endpoints-only conditioning envelope and concrete strict improvement (kappa 1.51949 versus 1.94868 for a 0/0.72076/3 spectrum). A two-mode equality and a three-mode worst-case isolate the role of interior spectrum, useful for finite-dimensional elliptic feedback preconditioning without suggesting a generic PDE theorem.
